scientific_integrity: The four-node identity and three-node obstruction are analytical proofs; 28 finite numerical consistency assertions supplement rather than replace them.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-complex-variable degree-two Bargmann–Fock polynomial space, strictly positive sampling weights and exact point evaluations are studied; older cubature literature may contain an equivalent rule. No publication-priority certification is asserted.
title: Four nodes are necessary and sufficient for exact tight sampling of quadratic Fock polynomials
